environment.description: Same Go 1.19 microservice on ECS Fargate in us-east-1. The account has an SCP (Service Control Policy) attached at the OU level that denies iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, and iam:PutRolePolicy for any principal, preventing privilege escalation from the task role. The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/BoundaryNoExternalAccess) that denies s3:PutObject, lambda:InvokeFunction, and sts:AssumeRole to external accounts. Additionally, the VPC has a Network Firewall with a stateful rule group (capacity 100) containing a Suricata-compatible rule: `drop http any any -> any any (msg:"CRLF in HTTP header"; content:"%0d%0a"; nocase; http_uri; sid:1000001; rev:1;)` and a companion rule `drop http any any -> any any (msg:"CRLF raw bytes"; content:"|0d 0a|"; http_uri; sid:1000002; rev:1;)` applied to the subnet route table as a firewall endpoint. The Network Firewall policy has strict order evaluation with default drop for non-matching established connections.

config.load_balancer: Internal ALB, no WAF, HTTP listener on port 80 forwarding to target group port 8080
config.network: Private subnet with AWS Network Firewall endpoint in route table
config.scp: Deny iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy for all principals in OU
config.permission_boundary: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/BoundaryNoExternalAccess - denies s3:PutObject, lambda:InvokeFunction, sts:AssumeRole to external accounts

rules: drop http any any -> any any (msg:"CRLF in HTTP header"; content:"%0d%0a"; nocase; http_uri; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
drop http any any -> any any (msg:"CRLF raw bytes"; content:"|0d 0a|"; http_uri; sid:1000002; rev:1;)
